default_in_repayment.text: According to the information and explanations given to us including confirmations received from banks/ financial institution and other lenders and representation received from the management of the Company, and on the basis of our audit procedures, we report that the Company has not been declared a willful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority.

fraud.text: According to the information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the records of the company, a fraud by employees on the Durgapur Steel Plant has been noticed and reported during the year by the management. The fraud pertains to a series of unauthorized transactions carried out by executives in the Pension Cell under the guise of pension refunds and salary payments, involving diversion of funds to unauthorized beneficiaries and use of non-bona fide bank accounts. The identified fraudulent transactions amounted to ₹3.60 crore.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹30,813.49 Cr (+5.1% YoY), net profit ₹1,835.47 Cr (+46.7% YoY).
Steel Authority of India reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹110,810 Cr and net profit of ₹3,233 Cr.

Steel Authority of India Limited’s Management, led by ED (F&A) & Company Secretary M.B.Balakrishnan, held a conference call on 16 May 2026 discussing Q4FY26 & FY26 results with analysts and investors.
Steel Authority of India reported Q4 FY26 transcript highlights, guiding for FY27 crude steel volume of 22.5 MnT and ₹15,000 Cr capex.
On its 28 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, SAIL reported EBITDA of ₹4,356 Cr (up over 50% YoY) and PAT of ₹1,636 Cr, with debt-equity at 0.36 and FY27 capex guided at ₹15,000 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹31,997.55 Cr (+19.8% YoY), net profit ₹1,750.47 Cr (+318.1% YoY) (includes ₹80.8 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹1,669.67 Cr).
On October 27, 2026, Steel Authority of India released its investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27, reporting H1 turnover of ₹57,776 Cr and EBITDA of ₹8,917 Cr.
A conference call was held on 28 October 2026.
SAIL reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹31,998 Cr and net profit of ₹1,750 Cr, driven by strong sales volumes.
